I couldn't find a named night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor in anything you can see. I checked #coastal-team, #coastal-random, #general, #help-it-ops, our DM and the shared Coastal files. The only related line is in the Coastal cheat sheet, which says engineering gave Driftmoor Marine Freight a manual CSV patch "for the night dispatcher". It gives no name or email, so I won't guess one.

Kwame is the best person to ask. He can tell you who the contact is and what their email address is.

Once you have the address, tell me. Driftmoor is outside pemberline.com, so anything addressed to them, even a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval first. I can prepare the patch note and ask Ruth for you.
